moments.title: The journey began before the safari.
moments.note: Highland context, family hospitality and a slower arrival gave the route a human beginning before the wildlife chapter.

moments.title: Serengeti was the centre of gravity.
moments.note: The route was built around wildlife time rather than collecting stops.

moments.title: Then the journey changed tempo.
moments.note: Stone Town and the coast were not filler after safari; they changed the ending of the trip.

items.name: Lion
items.fact: Lions are social cats that often live in prides. Sightings depend on habitat, time of day and animal movement.

items.name: African elephant
items.fact: Elephants move across large ranges in response to water, forage and season. Family groups are led by experienced females.

items.name: Giraffe
items.fact: Giraffes are browsers, feeding mainly on leaves and shoots that many other herbivores cannot reach.

items.name: Migration
items.fact: The migration is driven by rainfall, grass and water across the wider Serengeti–Mara ecosystem; exact herd position is never guaranteed.
